title: The Swapped Report
brief: The approved report was replaced before a client meeting. Explore the office, read the records, and find out what happened.

evidence.title: Maya's email
evidence.body: At 8:40, Maya sent a short email to the team. She asked everyone to use the approved report, version three, for the client meeting. She also wrote, 'Do not use the previous version.' The attachment name ended in v3.

evidence.title: Team chat
evidence.body: At 8:45, Nora asked in the team chat, 'Should I send the previous version?' Maya was preparing the meeting and did not answer at once. Nora wrote that she would check the shared folder. The chat does not show which file she finally chose.

evidence.title: File version history
evidence.body: The archive log shows that Leo uploaded version three at 8:30. At 8:50, Nora's account replaced the meeting file with version two. The log records an account and a time, but it cannot tell us why the change happened.

evidence.title: Meeting minutes
evidence.body: The internal meeting began at 8:45. The minutes say Leo joined the call and presented the new figures from 8:47 to 8:55. This record supports his account of where he was, but it does not prove who changed the client file.

evidence.title: Maya's statement
evidence.body: Maya says she meant the newly approved report, version three. She did not ask anyone to return to an older file. She was busy before the meeting and missed Nora's question in the chat. Later, she saw that the client file was different.

evidence.title: Nora's statement
evidence.body: Nora says she thought 'previous version' meant the file to send, not the file to avoid. She found version two in the shared folder and used it instead of version three. When she learned about the mistake, she told the team immediately.

npcs.name: Maya
dialogue: Please check the report instructions on the desk.
The exact version matters. Come back when you have read the email.

npcs.name: Leo
dialogue: I uploaded a revised report before the meeting.
The meeting notes may help you check the time.

npcs.name: Nora
dialogue: I prepared the file for the client meeting.
Please look at the records before we discuss what changed.

questions.explanation: Maya's email says to use the approved version three.

questions.prompt: What did Nora ask in the chat?

choices.text: Whether she should send the previous version

questions.explanation: Nora asked whether she should send the previous version.

questions.prompt: What does the version history show at 8:50?

choices.text: Nora's account replaced the file with version two

questions.explanation: The log records Nora's account replacing the meeting file at 8:50.

reviewItems.explanation: Previous describes something that came before.

reviewItems.prompt: Choose the best verb: Nora ___ version three with version two.
reviewItems.explanation: Replaced means put one thing in the place of another.

reviewItems.prompt: Complete the sentence: She used version two ___ of version three.
reviewItems.explanation: ‘Instead of’ introduces the choice that was not used.

reviewItems.prompt: Which record shows who changed the file at 8:50?
reviewItems.explanation: The version history records Nora's account at 8:50.

solution.explanation: Nora used version two because she misunderstood Maya's instruction. The version history and her statement support that conclusion.
